auto.text: Picks the right brain for each message
picker.projectKept: This project is kept on this device
cap.files.text: Drop in PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV or text files, and {name} reads them. Pictures and captures of your screen go to brains that can see.
cap.made.text: Ask for a Word document, a spreadsheet or another file, and save it with a click. Copy answers with their formatting, and download tables for Excel.
cap.documents.text: Documents kept beside the conversation: write in them with / for headings, lists and tables, turn words you choose bold or into a link, and move whole blocks. Changes from {name} show where they are, each to keep or undo.
cap.tables.text: Collections beside the conversation, each shown as a table or a board. Changes from {name} show marked, to keep or undo. For now, they need a brain in the cloud or a plan.
cap.computer.text: A computer in a sandbox in this tab, never this device itself: it runs commands, JavaScript and Python on your folder’s files or the project’s workspace, and reaches the internet as you allow.
cap.reflexes.text: A small helper on this device ({size}, once) that senses what you need: the right brain for each message, suggestions, new things to try. Nothing leaves this device.
cap.meaning.text: Finds what your files say, even in other words or another language, with a small helper on this device ({size}, once). Nothing leaves this device.
cap.meaning.hint: Ask about your files in other words than theirs.
cap.reader.text: Reads answers aloud in a natural voice made on this device ({size} a language, once). Nothing leaves this device.
cap.backup.text: Keep a copy of everything in one file, and restore it on any device.
cap.share.text: Send a task, or a page, chart, deck or picture, as a link that whoever you send it to can open.
cap.sync.text: Keeps your tasks, files and memory the same on your other computers, through a folder that OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive or Google Drive syncs.
cap.lock.text: Your tasks, files and keys open only with your passkey or password.
cap.brain-local.text: Private, free and offline: a brain that runs on this computer, if it is powerful enough.
cap.files.hint: Share a file, or paste a long text.
cap.documents.hint: Ask for a change to a document once it is written.
cap.tables.hint: Ask to keep track of something, such as job applications or expenses.
cap.computer.hint: Share a spreadsheet, or ask for exact numbers.
cap.memory.hint: Mention something lasting about you, like a preference.
cap.projects.hint: Keep coming back to the same subject.
cap.skills.hint: Ask for the same kind of thing three times.
cap.routines.hint: Ask for the same kind of thing on three different days.
cap.search.hint: Start five tasks, then ask about something only the web knows, like today’s news.
cap.connections.hint: Ask for something in a service you use, like your email.
cap.helpers.hint: Ask for a big task with several parts.
cap.check.hint: Get three answers that cite their sources.
cap.since.hint: Come back after a while, with a service connected.
cap.notifications.hint: Go to another tab or app while a task runs.
cap.names.hint: Start a few tasks in a project.
cap.share.hint: Save a copy of a task.
cap.sync.hint: Mention that you also use another computer.
cap.lock.hint: Connect a service, or start ten tasks.
cap.brain-local.hint: Choose the brain that runs on this device.
cap.memory.text: {name} remembers the lasting things you mention, like preferences, facts and corrections. You can see and change all of it.
cap.projects.text: Anything you keep coming back to gets its own room: its tasks, files, notes and light.
cap.folders.hint: Drop a folder on the conversation.
cap.folders.text: Opens a task or a project on a folder of this computer: {name} finds, reads and changes its files where they are, and shows you each change first.
cap.skills.text: When you ask for the same kind of thing again and again, {name} can save how it is done, and do it the same way every time.
cap.routines.text: Tasks done on their own every hour, day, week or month, or once later, like a reminder: while this tab is open, or as soon as you’re back.
projects.name: Name
projects.local: Keep this project on this device
projects.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”, with all its tasks, files and notes? This can’t be undone.
cap.flows.hint: Ask twice for something that takes several steps.
cap.flows.text: The steps of a task you repeat, drawn beside the conversation: see them, change them, and run them again by hand or on a schedule. Any task can be seen as a flow too.
cap.search.text: {name} looks things up on the web when a question needs facts it doesn’t have, and shows where each answer comes from.
cap.browser.text: Shows web pages beside the conversation, with back, forward and reload. {name} can open pages there too, and knows which one is open.
cap.connections.text: Connect the services you use, like your email or documents. {name} reads and acts there only with your approval.
cap.live.text: Talk with {name} hands-free: it listens, answers aloud, and stops when you speak. About {size}, once.
connections.keyHint: Only if the service gave you a key. Otherwise you’ll be asked to sign in.
connections.failed: Couldn’t connect. Check the address: some services don’t accept connections from a browser yet.
connections.needsKey: This service needs you to sign in, or a key.
connections.failedKnown: Couldn’t connect to {service}. Try again in a moment.
gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.text: Some services don’t accept connections from a browser yet. {name} can reach them through a gateway, run by your organization or by you: give its address here.
cap.helpers.text: For a big task, {name} splits the work into parts, each done by a helper, all at the same time. You approve what they do, one card at a time.
cap.apps.hint: Ask for something an app could do.
cap.apps.text: Add apps to do more, like checking what is sent. Each is kept away from your files and keys, and does only what you allowed.
cap.check.text: {name} checks each claim of an answer against the source it cites, and shows you what the sources don’t support.
cap.since.text: When you come back, a short brief of what’s new in your connected services. It only reads, and nothing is read while this tab is closed.
cap.notifications.text: A notification when a task is done or waits for you while you’re away. Only its title shows, never the answer.
cap.names.text: Give a project’s assistant a name of its own, and a few words on how it should be.
projects.persona: How it should be, in a few words
projects.personaHint: For example: warm and brief, like a pastry chef
keyboard.recall: Earlier requests, when your message is empty
keyboard.edit: Edit a request, when it is selected
settings.voiceText: Each answer is read in its own language, by a voice on this device.
settings.rulesText: Choose what {name} can do on its own, what it should ask you about first, and what it must never do.
guards.title: For one kind of action or one service
guards.text: Ask first, or never do it, for one kind of action or one service; if you like, only when the answer to a question about it is yes. These rules never allow more than those above.
guards.if: Only if the answer is yes to… (optional)
guards.when: When the answer is yes to “{question}”
kind.read.label: Reading files
kind.edit.label: Creating and changing files
kind.delete.label: Deleting files
kind.move.label: Moving and renaming
kind.search.label: Searching
kind.execute.label: Running calculations
kind.fetch.label: Using the internet
kind.other.label: Sending and sharing
kind.plan.label: Starting a long task
seal.title: This device’s seal
seal.text: Certificates saved here are sealed with a key that never leaves this device. Whoever relies on them can check this fingerprint, or agree on it with you beforehand.
pages.title: Web pages
pages.text: What a web page may do when it opens beside the conversation.
pages.fullscreenText: Slides, games and videos can fill the screen.
pages.downloadsText: Its buttons can save a table or a picture it made.
pages.webText: Pictures, fonts and code it links to. Those sites can tell the page was opened.
pages.network: Send and receive over the internet
pages.networkText: Its code can reach the sites you allow. Only for pages you trust.
pages.mapsText: From a map service on the internet, which sees the places they show.
pages.sitesText: Type a site, then press Enter. * is any site; *.example.com is every address of example.com.
knows.title: What {name} knows about you
you.name: Your name
cap.find.text: Finds any task, file or setting as you type: part of a word is enough.
brain.key.label: Key
brain.device.title: On this device
brain.device.ready: The brain on this device is ready
cap.machine.hint: Ask to run a site’s dev server, such as npm run dev.
cap.machine.text: Runs the computer’s commands on this device itself, in a folder of yours, with its own programs and servers: a site’s dev server shows in the browser. Each command is asked first, and Ctrl+C in your terminal stops it all.
cap.pictures.text: Pictures and short films from a description, or a picture of yours changed: by the brains you connect, or privately on this device. A film is asked about first, since it costs more.
